{"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :-
1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55~60 HRC.
2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm.
3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT.
4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat_treatment field states '---' (none), but note N2 explicitly requires case hardening to 55–60 HRC with a 0.8–1.2 mm case depth. This contradiction can cause the part to be manufactured without the required hardness, leading to premature wear or failure. The designer should update the title block heat_treatment field to reflect the case hardening requirement specified in N2.","recommended_correction":"Change the title block heat_treatment field from '---' to match the case hardening specification in note N2."}]}
